components.heading: Interpretation.
components.text: In the interpretation and application, the provisions of this chapter shall be held to be minimum requirements to protect the health and safety of the public and shall not be deemed a limitation or repeal of any other powers granted by Kansas statutes. (Ord. 20425 § 6, 6-20-23.)
